# Find magenta position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
mag_pos = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'M':
        b = n['boundary']
        mag_pos = (b[0][0], b[0][1])
        print(f"Magenta at: {mag_pos}")
        break

# Try clicking magenta

    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': mag_pos[0], 'col': mag_pos[1]}])
    print(f"After magenta click: done={last_action_result.get('done')}")
    
    # Check state

    g_count = sum(1 for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'G')
    print(f"G objects: {g_count}")
    
    for n in seg2['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('W', 'G', 'M') and n['pixels'] >= 5:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            print(f"{n['color']} (px={n['pixels']}): ({min(rows)},{min(cols)})-({max(rows)},{max(cols)})")
    
    if last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("Level completed!")
